source_policy.priority: first-party specialist articles, original expert blogs, studies with methods, primary business documents
source_policy.secondary_media_use: discovery only; verify primary before using as sole factual basis

public_output.source_urls: Never printed as raw URL to the audience; retained privately for fact checking
public_output.publisher_name: Do not name reporting outlets for decoration; real study author/brand may be relevant if grounded
public_output.narrative_format: Separate crafted channel copy, never concatenate arbitrary story frames or fixed indices

deployment: No recurring publish or NovinHub queue before user sign-off and week-long shadow evaluation
note: The registry is an editorial preference list, not permission to scrape paid blogs or proof a specific article was read.
